work_item.title: Dark/Light Theme Implementation
work_item.description: 🚩 AC Addressed (Required) Implement dark/light theme support Redesign query interface with modern, clean aesthetics 💡 What do you want to accomplish? (Required) Develop a comprehensive theming system using CSS custom properties that supports both dark and light themes with proper contrast ratios meeting WCAG accessibility standards. Implement intelligent theme detection that respects user's system preference on first visit, with a toggle control for manual switching and persistent storage of user preference across sessions. Create smooth theme transition animations and ensure all UI components, including syntax highlighting and data visualizations, properly adapt to both theme variants. 📋 Testability Considerations (Required) Visual testing for all components in both dark and light themes Accessibility testing for contrast ratios in both themes (WCAG 2.1 AA compliance) Browser testing for CSS custom property support and fallbacks User preference persistence testing across browser sessions Theme transition animation performance testing Integration testing with existing component library ⚙ Implementation (Optional) ✋ Technical Dependencies CSS custom properties support in target browsers Component library theming architecture User preference storage mechanism (localStorage/backend) 🛠️ Engineering Work To Be Implemented CSS custom property-based theming system Theme toggle component with state management Dark theme color palette design with accessibility compliance Theme-aware syntax highlighting for query editor Theme transition animations and performance optimization System preference detection and user preference persistence ⚠ Risks & Mitigations Risk: Theme switching may cause visual glitches or performance issues during transitions Mitigation 1: Implement CSS transitions carefully to avoid layout shifts Mitigation 2: Add option to disable animations for users with motion sensitivity Risk: Third-party components may not support custom theming Mitigation 1: Create theme adaptation layer for external components Mitigation 2: Select theme-compatible libraries or build custom alternatives
acceptance_criteria: All UI components render correctly in both dark and light themes without visual glitches
Color contrast ratios meet or exceed WCAG 2.1 AA standards in both themes
On first visit, theme matches user's system preference automatically
User can toggle theme manually via a visible control
User's theme preference persists across browser sessions
Theme transitions animate smoothly without layout shifts or performance degradation
Accessibility tests confirm compliance with motion sensitivity preferences (option to disable animations)
Third-party components adapt correctly to theme changes or are replaced with compatible alternatives
Browser compatibility verified for CSS custom properties with appropriate fallbacks

analysis.recommended_approach: Start by designing an accessible dark theme color palette and defining CSS custom properties for both themes. Implement system preference detection and user preference persistence using localStorage or backend storage. Develop a theme toggle component with state management. Integrate theme-aware styling into all UI components including syntax highlighting and data visualizations. Use CSS transitions carefully to enable smooth animations and provide an option to disable animations for motion-sensitive users. Create a theme adaptation layer for third-party components or replace incompatible libraries. Conduct thorough visual, accessibility, and browser compatibility testing before rollout.

implementation_steps.description: Design accessible dark and light theme color palettes and define CSS custom properties for both themes in a dedicated stylesheet.
implementation_steps.validation: Verify CSS variables cover all UI color needs and meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios using accessibility tools.

implementation_steps.description: Implement intelligent theme detection based on user's system preference on first visit and create persistence utilities for storing user theme preference.
implementation_steps.validation: Test detection logic on different system themes and verify persistence across browser sessions.

implementation_steps.description: Develop a ThemeToggle React component with state management to allow manual switching between dark and light themes, integrating persistence and detection logic.
implementation_steps.validation: Ensure toggle control is visible, functional, and updates theme state and persistence correctly.

implementation_steps.description: Integrate theme-aware styling into all UI components, including redesigning the query interface with modern aesthetics and implementing theme-aware syntax highlighting.
implementation_steps.validation: Check all UI components render correctly in both themes without visual glitches and syntax highlighting adapts properly.

implementation_steps.description: Create smooth theme transition animations with performance optimization and add an option to disable animations respecting user motion sensitivity preferences.
implementation_steps.validation: Verify smooth transitions without layout shifts and confirm animations can be disabled via user preference.

implementation_steps.description: Develop a theme adaptation layer or replace third-party components that do not support custom theming to ensure consistent appearance across themes.
implementation_steps.validation: Confirm all third-party components adapt correctly or are replaced with compatible alternatives.

implementation_steps.description: Implement accessibility and visual testing for both dark and light themes, including contrast ratio verification, motion sensitivity compliance, and browser compatibility checks.
implementation_steps.validation: Run automated and manual tests confirming all acceptance criteria are met.

implementation.pr_description: Implemented a comprehensive dark/light theme system using CSS custom properties with WCAG 2.1 AA compliant color palettes. Added intelligent theme detection respecting user system preferences on first visit, a manual toggle control with persistent storage, and smooth animated transitions with motion sensitivity support. Updated all UI components including query interface and syntax highlighting to adapt to themes. Ensured third-party components compatibility and conducted thorough accessibility, visual, and browser compatibility testing.
